title: Report the city a shipment leaves from
task: In package `dispatch` I have a `Shipment` that is fulfilled from a `Warehouse`, which sits at an `Address` with a street, a city, and a country. Dispatch notices need one line like "Leaves from Manila" for a shipment, so write `DepartureNotice(s Shipment) string`. Model the three types however you think is right, but I don't want the notice reaching through the whole object graph if any of those types end up hiding their fields behind methods. Test the notice for one shipment.
